GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To settle further forward; settled outside lead. Rdr reported the mare made a harsh respiratory noise mid-race and soon after came under heavy pressure, and when it gave no response to his riding he eased it down as he was concerned there may be something amiss. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be lame (1/5) in the off-hind leg. Tnr was advised a vet clearance will be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly & from wide barrier was shifted behind rnrs in early stages. Near 100m shifted outwards to continue into clear running. When qst, rdr std intended to settle in a closer position near midfield. Std when positioned at rear, nearing the 600m she contemplated shifting three-wide to improve, however due to increasing tempo she elected to remain closer to rail & look for runs towards the inside. Added on entering home straight she intended to shift outwards to improve, but was momentarily held up passing the 400m before shifting inwards to secure clear running near the 300m.
